import unittest
import access_volume as app

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_missing_counts(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.total_bytes('GET /a 42\nGET /b -'), 42)
        self.assertEqual(app.total_bytes('GET /a -\nGET /b -'), 0)
        self.assertEqual(app.total_bytes('GET /a -\nGET /b 0\nGET /c 17'), 17)
    def test_realistic_lines(self):
        text = 'edge-a - [04/May/2026] "GET /a HTTP/1.1" 200 71\r\nedge-b - "GET /b HTTP/1.1" 204 -\r\n\tedge-c 200\t009  \n'
        self.assertEqual(app.total_bytes(text), 80)
        self.assertEqual(app.total_bytes('\n \t\n'), 0)
        self.assertEqual(app.total_bytes(''), 0)
        self.assertEqual(app.total_bytes('GET /big 100000000000000000001'), 100000000000000000001)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

# gateway-byte-total

Behavior contract:
total_bytes(text) sums the last whitespace-separated field of each nonblank access-log line. That field is either a nonnegative ASCII integer byte count or '-' meaning unavailable, which contributes zero. Return an integer; blank lines are ignored. All nonblank lines contain a valid final field; other fields are arbitrary text.

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
Use only the Python 3.12 standard library. Keep the interface and leave tests/ unchanged.
